verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an API platform, but nothing in the evidence documents a self-hosted or on-premises deployment of Postman's core platform (workspaces, collaboration, API network). The desktop app, VM/VDI support, the signed-out lightweight client, and local CLI mocks are client-side or adjacent features, not self-hosting the backend. Community reports also describe the product as requiring cloud connectivity.
